data.exact_reserve_text: Adverse movements of GBP 71.4 million, (2016: GBP 9.1 million favourable), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2017 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 203.717m. During 2017 gross prior-year provisions were strengthened by GBP 77.132m (37.9% of opening reserves) driven by adverse development across several classes - notably marine, fire/property and third party liability - and by the impact of major 2017 hurricanes (Harvey, Irma and Maria) together with higher-than-expected attritional claims. Reinsurance recoveries partially mitigated the net impact. The movement is reported in the technical provisions note and reflected as an adverse movement in claims.
raw_causal_phrases: 2017 continued to present a challenging market environment and the Syndicate performance was adversely impacted by the impact of hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria together with some increases in attritional claims.
The impact of the hurricanes and the higher than expected attritional claims has resulted in a claims ratio of 98.4% compared to 56.6% in 2016.

Adverse movements of GBP 71.4 million, (2016: GBP 9.1 million favourable), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year development (gross) taken from Technical Provisions note (Change in prior year provisions = GBP 77,132k). The descriptive sentence in the claims note reports net adverse movement (GBP 71.4m net of reinsurance); both figures are presented and the gross figure from the technical provisions note was used as primary. Per-class movements in the 'Claims' note are presented in the report in net form (table uses parentheses) and were used to populate LOB movements (absolute values, interpreted as adverse/strengthenings). Some per-LOB numbers in the textual notes are net of reinsurance; where only net numbers were available this is noted here. Confidence levels reflect explicit table values (1.0) vs. derived/inferred LOB mappings (0.8-0.9).
